title: Clear a corner
prompt: Pick up three pieces of litter here and bin them. Snap a photo of the tidied spot.

title: Bench tidy
prompt: Leave this bench cleaner than you found it. Photograph the result.

title: Water a thirsty plant
prompt: Find a public planter or street tree that looks dry and give it some water.

title: Notice one growing thing
prompt: Photograph one plant, flower, or tree here that you would normally walk past.

title: A genuine hello
prompt: Greet someone nearby with a real hello or a nod. Then photograph the place (no faces needed).

title: Thank someone working
prompt: Thank a shop worker, cleaner, or driver for what they do. Photograph the storefront or stop.

title: Leave a note of thanks
prompt: Write a short, kind Echo anchored here for the next person to find.

title: Small gift
prompt: Leave a book, a coin for a meter, or something small and useful for a stranger. Photograph where you left it.

title: Hold the door, carry the bag
prompt: Offer one small, practical help to someone here. Photograph the location afterward.

title: Give directions
prompt: If someone looks lost, offer directions — or just be ready to. Photograph the crossing or landmark.

title: Report what's broken
prompt: Spot something broken or unsafe (a light, a sign) and report it to the city. Photograph it.

title: Return a stray trolley
prompt: Return an abandoned shopping trolley or tidy a shared space. Photograph the result.

title: Encouragement here
prompt: Leave an Echo with one encouraging line for whoever passes this spot next.

title: Name something good
prompt: Leave an Echo naming one good thing about this place.

title: Steady the shatter
prompt: This Fracture is unstable. Breathe with the pacer until the pattern settles, then solve it.

title: Before you react
prompt: Take a full breathing cycle before moving on. Let the puzzle come back together.

title: Reset point
prompt: A place to pause. Complete the paced breathing to stabilise the mandala.

title: Cool the moment
prompt: Heart racing? Breathe through the pacer and watch the fragments align.

title: Two to mend
prompt: This Fracture needs two Weavers. Meet a partner here, share the code, and solve it together.

title: Bridge the gap
prompt: Find another player at this spot. Open a session and complete the shared pattern.

title: In sync
prompt: A puzzle only two can solve. Pair up here and resonate together.

title: Sit with someone
prompt: If someone's alone and open to it, share a moment or a few words. Photograph the spot after.
